identity_check: The served HTML and JavaScript hashes match canonical Evidence Room. The variant query is ignored by the current router.

clarity.finding: The conclusion and proof action are clear, but the blocking contradiction is not part of the first decision unit.

hierarchy.finding: The oversized conclusion dominates while Cause Verdict and Recommendation Readiness are visually remote from their reasons.

typography.finding: The sans and mono pairing is disciplined, but display scale and repeated uppercase labels still feel authored by a design recipe.

motion.finding: Motion is restrained and reduced-motion safe; selection feedback remains functional rather than decorative.

brand_consistency.finding: The shell is coherent, but the fixed proof dock reads as generic application chrome instead of case-specific authority.

graph_legibility.finding: Claims is substantially improved, but the Review screen does not expose how the selected contradiction maps into graph and proof context.

mobile.finding: At 390 by 844 the strongest contradiction begins below the first viewport, so the most important blocker is delayed.

revision: Replace the editorial Review composition with a compact decision header, visible separate axes and blocker reasons, support-versus-contradiction comparison, and an inline authority trail to exact proof. Prioritize the blocker on mobile.
